from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentCase(BaseModel):
    """The legal content of a single judgment document extracted for classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The actual title of the judgment document as provided in the text")
    legal_domain: str = Field(description="The broad legal category of the document (e.g., 'Civil', 'Criminal', 'Administrative')")
    cause_type: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action, charge, or dispute (e.g., 'Patent Infringement', 'Traffic Accident', 'Administrative Fine')")
    key_parties: list[str] = Field(description="Names of key parties or entities involved (plaintiff, defendant, agency, etc.)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for extracted case information from a single document."""
    cases: list[JudgmentCase] = Field(description="List of judgment case details found in the document")
